---
title: "Exercise — Produce with Generative AI"
description: "Document the production workflow and capability requirements for your concept."
order: 7
---

## Task

Write a `production.md` file documenting the production workflow and capability
requirements for your own concept, then render your screenplay.

## Steps

1. **Declare required capabilities.** Adapt the neutral capability list to your
   project:

   ```yaml
   capabilities:
     multi_voice: true
     narration: true
     sound_effects: true
     ambience: true
     scene_control: true
     audio_export: true
   ```

   If your story needs something extra (for example, distinct music cues per
   scene), add it as a capability.

2. **Evaluate at least one provider.** Take a provider you have access to and
   check it against your capability list. Record which capabilities it satisfies
   and which it lacks.

3. **Document the workflow.** Write the steps you will take to render your
   `screenplay.md` into audio — import, voices, ambience, SFX, pacing, export.

4. **Render your screenplay.** Produce `audio-play.mp3` using your chosen
   provider.

5. **Record caveats.** Note any licensing restrictions, watermarks, generation
   limits, or export restrictions on the free tier you used.

## Checklist

- [ ] Capabilities are declared as a neutral list in `production.md`.
- [ ] At least one provider is evaluated against the capability list.
- [ ] The workflow is documented as steps, not provider-specific UI.
- [ ] `audio-play.mp3` was produced.
- [ ] Free-tier caveats, if any, are recorded.
